# braintrust_api_key (Resource)

Manages a Braintrust API key.

**Important:** The raw API key (`key`) is only exposed at creation time and stored in Terraform state. It cannot be retrieved again from the API. Treat the Terraform state as sensitive.

API keys are **immutable** — any attribute change requires destroying and recreating the key. Import is not supported because the raw key cannot be recovered.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the API key. Does not have to be unique.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Date of API key creation.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the API key (UUID).
- `key` (String, Sensitive) The raw API key. Only exposed at creation time and stored in Terraform state.
- `org_id` (String) Unique identifier for the organization.
- `preview_name` (String) A preview/masked version of the key name.
- `user_id` (String) Unique identifier for the user who owns this key.
